claude.sample_unit: patients (protocol-locked test set, from 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records)

links.outcome: Repair and specificity endpoints for LLM over-trust when reliability evidence is provided
links.effect: Baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, all paired CIs excluding zero; UHR increases 0.67 pp (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7).
links.quote: On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7).
